editorial.description_en: Haze where the sea meets the sky and the line between them stops being visible.
editorial.description_ja: 沖の霞のような、青と緑のあいだの色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.762, C 0.058, h 232.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 沖 (oki, the offing) + 霞 (kasumi, haze), rendaku to -gasumi. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Offing Haze" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 沖霞. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ko-men at ΔE00 3.1, to-yama at ΔE00 4.6, samu-zora at ΔE00 7.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (52°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
